go-xai 0.1.0

- Initial release of an unofficial Go client for the xAI (Grok) REST API.
- Provides strongly typed methods for all endpoints, generated via oapi-codegen.
- Supports chat completions, responses, Anthropic-style messages, embeddings, tokenization, image/video generation, files, skills, document search, model listing, and API key info.
- Authentication via bearer API key set from an environment variable.
- Includes full usage and security guidance in documentation.
